description.content: OAuth 2.0 token management.
Obtain a JWT access token using OAuth 2.0 client credentials. The token is valid for 10 hours and must be passed as a Bearer token in the Authorization header.

The StoneX Clearing REST API provides programmatic access to accounts, trading, and document management for institutional clearing clients. Uses OAuth 2.0 authentication with JWT tokens (10-hour lifetime). Available in UAT and production environments.
